items.title: Warframe Tau Release Date: December 9, 2026
items.summary: Warframe: Tau, a free update Digital Extremes says would have been Warframe 2, launches December 9, 2026 with a new star system, Brysko and Kullervo Prime.
items.content:
Digital Extremes has dated Warframe: Tau, the free expansion that takes the 13-year-old game beyond its original solar system, for December 9, 2026, the studio announced in a Steam news post on November 27.

The update lands on PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, and mobile at the same time, and it costs nothing. For the first time since Warframe launched on March 25, 2013, players get a second Star Chart: a whole new star system alongside the Origin System they have known for 13 years.

Creative director Rebecca Ford has been blunt about the scale. “It’s massive, it is a second solar system, and it is, in many ways, a banner moment for just how much more Warframe we’re going to be making,” she told the Epic Games Store blog. “Alone, by now, this would have been Warframe 2, but we’re just going for it.” Ford said the studio never seriously entertained shipping a sequel, because “it would destroy us to do a sequel.”

Two of Tau’s five regions are playable at launch, according to a press pre-briefing held ahead of Devstream 199. Fornax is the primary planet, a rain-slicked noir metropolis where the Sentients built their civilization, with three linked districts players can move between: a club called the Lastbloom Lounge, an industrial zone Digital Extremes is calling Manifold 90-BF, and a third area the studio is deliberately leaving undescribed until launch. Fornax also has a moon, Perita, a shifting desert that ships with six modes, Survival and Exterminate among them.

Tau’s story quest runs roughly two hours and puts players in the shoes of a new frame: Brysko, a gumshoe-style investigator Warframe with Matthew Mercer’s voice behind it, and the first Warframe that talks. A new Syndicate called the Fornax Informer, a 1920s-style broadsheet staffed entirely by children, ties the planet’s three districts together.

Kullervo Prime Access debuts the same day, December 9, bringing the Rauta Prime shotgun and the Vitrica Prime heavy blade alongside the new Prime Warframe. The launch follows Epoch Operation: Taubound, which community director Megan Everett called Warframe’s most participated in-game event in its history, an event in which an entire planet was eaten to set up the trip to Tau.

Ford said players who left Warframe and return for Tau will pick up exactly where they quit, and she called bringing those returning players back her biggest white whale right now. Beyond Tau, Digital Extremes has 2027 mapped with a new chapter of Infested content set back in the Origin System, plus Nezha and Loki Heirloom collections. Warframe is nominated for Best Community Support at this year’s Game Awards.

items.title: Warframe's Tau expansion launches in December with new Star System
items.summary: A new Warframe voiced by Matthew Mercer, a new Star System, and more.
items.content:
All News Warframe’s new expansion launches in December for free (Image: Digital Extremes).

{" "} Warframe's Tau expansion launches in December with new Star System .iframe-media {width: 100%;aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} .img-media {width: 100%;aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} .a-img-media {aspect-ratio: auto 16/9;} A new Warframe voiced by Matthew Mercer, a new Star System, and more. Warframe, the free-to-play sci-fi third-person-shooter, has revealed the release date for its highly-anticipated upcoming expansion Tau. This new expansion takes players to an all-new Star System, adds a new noir-themed Warframe called Brysko, and continues the long-running main story.

The expansion will launch for free on all platforms on 9 December, 2026.

Game developer Digital Extremes held a livestream this week to announce more details on the future of its seminal looter-shooter Warframe. The game’s new expansion, Tau, takes players to the titular Star System after years of in-game teases. This means that the game is finally adding a second Star System for players to explore, on top of the Origin System.

This new Star System includes the ringed city Fornax, a noir-themed sci-fi location that features an interconnected social hub system filled with NPCs and vendors, and a few new in-game features for players to dive into. For example, the city adds a Night Walk mode, which allows players to explore the city in first-person mode and gather resources. Additionally, players can drive around in the Ringway Network in a new minigame.

New game modes like Racket, where players must recover stolen funds, or Mayhem, where players must aptly cause destruction are also being added. On top of that, four remixed mission types are also coming, like a new vault heist version of Spy.

The expansion’s Steel Path adds new mini-bosses, and Warframe Syndicates are also getting turned into the Fornax Informer in Tau. In this feature, players will collect clues, interrogate sub-factions, and eventually rank up the Fornax Informer to learn more about the Star System via a detective-like side-story.

Kullervo Prime Access is also launching with Warframe: Tau on 9 December, and new TennoGen and Heirloom cosmetics are being added to the game in the near future. New trailers for both Warframe and Digital Extremes’ next game Soulframe will also be shown at The Game Awards 2026.

items.title: Warframe's Tau Expansion Is Big Enough To Be a Sequel and Lands on December 9
Warframe: Tau Officially Confirmed For December 9 Release
items.summary: Digital Extremes confirmed this week that Warframe: Tau will officially be released on December 9, along with a few more updates.
items.content:
Posted in: Digital Extremes , Games , Soulframe , Video Games , Warframe | Tagged: Warframe: Tau

Digital Extremes confirmed this week that Warframe: Tau will officially be released on December 9, along with a few more updates.

Digital Extremes held its latest Devstream for both Warframe and Soulframe this afternoon, confirming that Warframe: Tau will be released on December 9. Essentially, they gave players the final pieces of info heading into the update about all the content on the way, along with new community events, a Game Awards Twitch drop, and Kullervo Prime access . We have the full rundown of what was talked about for Warframe: Tau below, along with the latest trailer.

Dock on the ringed city of Fornax and discover Warframe's first interconnected social hub system full of various characters and vendors to meet. Travel seamlessly between three different hubs, either on foot in a scenic Night Walk to gather resources, or ride the Ringway Network in a car mini-game. Seek out brand-new game modes like Racket, where squads must recover stolen funds and deliver them to extorted neighborhoods, or Mayhem, and disrupt unsavory operations of the mob by literally causing destruction and mayhem. Explore four remixed versions of existing mission types, like the new vault heist version of Spy missions, across the crime-riddled city while utilizing new combinable Tau damage types. Take on new challenges with Tau's Steel Path , which introduces the hulking Hokra Brothers as mini-bosses in missions.

Warframe Syndicates take a new form in Tau and become The Fornax Informer . Collect clues and interrogate the three sub-factions: Larynde's Dazzlers, The Haulers, and a yet-to-be-revealed group, leading to a climactic conclusion. Rank up as The Fornax Informer to solve scandals, learn more about Tau, and earn exclusive rewards.

Kullervo Prime, the treacherous sinner, arrives with increased armor and energy, draped in Orokin gold and traces of Void scarring. Wield the latest in Prime weaponry with two new weapons: the Rauta Prime shotgun and the Vitrica Prime heavy blade. Kullervo Prime is available to earn for free via gameplay or unlock instantly in the Warframe Market.

Try on the latest community-created TennoGen Tau cosmetic collection arriving alongside Warframe: Tau. Including the Voruna Niou Warframe Skin by Goosmo, Niou Syandana backpiece by Goosmo, Nokko Mycosec Alt. Helmet by edwino22 , Cykronox Signa headpiece by Vendrid, and the Heavy Blade Ignakk Weapon Skin by mizi. Turn heads with the next set of Heirloom cosmetic skins for Nezha (co-developed with Sumo Digital ) and Loki , set to be released in early 2027 alongside ability balancing for Loki.

items.title: Warframe: Tau Available December 9
items.summary: A new era of Warframe begins December 9! After 13 years of exploring the Origin System, it’s time to venture into an entirely new star chart when Warframe: Tau launches on all platforms! Explore the mafia-riddled metropolis of Fornax and th
items.content:
A new era of Warframe begins December 9! After 13 years of exploring the Origin System, it’s time to venture into an entirely new star chart when Warframe: Tau launches on all platforms! Explore the mafia-riddled metropolis of Fornax and the badlands of Perita, take on new Missions, uncover mysteries and much more. Catch up on everything revealed during Devstream 199 and prepare for the journey ahead! Watch the Warframe: Tau Gameplay Trailer:

Welcome to Fornax

Step into the living Sentient metropolis of Fornax, where a dangerous criminal underworld operates under the watchful eye of The Hunra. Explore interconnected hubs throughout the city, from the Lastbloom Lounge to Manifold 90-BF, and discover new factions, enemies and activities along the way. Take to the skies through the Tau Highway Network or explore the streets on foot with the Night Walk, gathering resources and uncovering secrets throughout the metropolis.

New Syndicates and Bounties

Make new connections with The Fornax Informer, an all-new Syndicate featuring three distinct factions working together. Work with Larynde at the Lastbloom Lounge, Ikkilyst at Manifold 90-BF and a third Faction you’ll discover during the Tau Quest. Take on new Hub Bounties, earn Standing and unlock unique Rewards.

New Game Modes and Minigames

There’s no shortage of trouble in Fornax! Protect the neighborhoods from The Hunra’s criminal operations in Racket, or cause some chaos of your own in Mayhem by destroying vehicles, cash machines and more. Looking for a change of pace? Race through the highways of Fornax, try your luck at Portau or explore additional minigames throughout the city.

The Fornax Informer

There’s a mystery lurking beneath the streets of Fornax… Work with Larynde to uncover the source of threatening messages circulating through the city in an all-new detective inspired experience. Keep your eyes peeled — you never know what secrets might be hiding in plain sight.

Tau Steel Path

A new star system means a new Path to conquer! Test your strength against heightened enemy difficulty in Tau’s Steel Path, featuring new Tau Steel Essence Alerts and Omnia Void Relics. Face off against The Hunra’s formidable Enforcers, the Hokra Brothers, and earn Rewards as you take on the toughest challenges Tau has to offer.

Kullervo Prime Access

Kullervo Prime arrives December 9! Once condemned, the tormented warrior returns gilded in gold, bearing the scars of his past. Unleash his deadly melee prowess alongside Rauta Prime, Vitrica Prime and new Prime Accessories. No sentence can keep Kullervo Prime from claiming his vengeance. Witness the Kullervo Prime Trailer:

TennoGen Tau

Show off your Fashion Frame with five new community-created Customizations arriving December 9! Discover the Voruna Niou Skin and Niou Syandana, Nokko’s first-ever TennoGen Cosmetic with the Mycosec Helmet, the Cykronox Signa and Heavy Blade Ignakk Skin. There’s plenty of new fashion to explore, all created by the talented artists of the Warframe community!

More to Come!

The excitement doesn’t end with Tau, Tenno! Tune into The Game Awards on December 10 for an all-new Warframe: Tau Trailer. Watch the show on Twitch for 30 minutes to earn a free Caliban Warframe as an official Twitch Drop. That’s not all. Look forward to Nezha and Loki Heirloom arriving together in early 2027, along with an Ability Retouch for Loki. A new chapter awaits, Tenno. Explore everything coming with Warframe: Tau when it launches on all platforms on December 9!

items.title: Warframe Devstream 199 Breakdown
items.summary: Devstream 199 for Warframe has just wrapped up on all official channels, here are all of the highlights from the stream!
items.content:
Devstream 199 for Warframe has just wrapped up on all official channels. Digital Extremes used this stream to talk about more things involving Tau. But not just about its gameplay system changes, but also its release date, what missions you can expect, and an unexpected (but also expected) romance waiting in the wings for all players. Here is everything we learned from Devstream 199!

That’s right, the biggest takeaway from the stream is the update’s release date. That being December 9th (before The Game Awards). This means in a little under 2 weeks, we will all get to journey to the next solar system in Warframe (with a dedicated tab and star chart that looks great!) This was announced with a very bombastic trailer including new story moments, music and of course, gameplay:

The cinematic quest will be around 2-3 hours to complete also. It will be launching with two locations, Fornax and Perita, alongside 3 new weapons including a new shotgun, and a pair of tonfas and the detective frame, Brysko (voiced by Matt Mercer).

Perita will launch its own faction, the Cleaving Glaive, and will have 6 new missions to take on. Including a new survival mission with a few environmental twists, like a sandstorm to block player visibility. Fornax, on the other hand, is going to be very meaty. It will have, for the first time in a long time, a brand new spy mission with traps and puzzles (like Lua) alongside its own faction and little bits of secrets to uncover.

But for those who want to know if there will be consequences of Eris being eaten by Praghasa, there are. There will be smaller updates in the Origin System after Tau that will go over the revenge the infested want for Eris being gone.

While Perita will have its own faction and reputation to grind out, Fornax is going to have the same but with a lot more included. Just like Perita, there will be 6 missions, including the aforementioned new spy mission. But there will be 3 hubs altogether. When doing bounties in Fornax, you will go from one hub to the next, such as the casino and the manifold that was shown during the last Devstream . But if you want to go to another hub immediately, you can do so by driving the car shown in the TennoCon 2026 demo , and there will be some fun gameplay thrown in during the trips.

You can collect resources, attack other mob cars, and avoid other hazards before landing at the next destination. There will also be little mysteries for you to look into, and you can even do some detective work in first-person mode. One of the mysteries even involves a little scandal the singer at the casino, Larynde, is involved in, and there was even a tease of a possible romance scene. They also showed the new Steel Path adversaries, the Hokra brothers, and their unique attacks. Also shown during the Devstream is that you can play Portau with not only NPCs but other players and make bets.

Both Fornax and Perita will have reputation items to collect while playing the missions. But what makes Fornax stand out even more is the progression system with little upgrades you can unlock. The upgrades are permanent, and you can pick which ones you want active.

Kullervo Prime is the next Prime Warframe coming to the game on December 9th with Tau. He will arrive with the Rauta Prime and Vitriga Prime. He was announced with a fantastic trailer featuring styanax prime as well:

Not only that, they revealed that Loki will be getting a light rework next year. They mentioned it might be something akin to Banshee’s rework earlier in the year. This means it will not be an overhaul of his abilities. Instead, it will be a streamlining to make his use cases more prevalent and accessible to players. But one thing viewers were not expecting was the reveal of the Loki heirloom skin. This skin is being made by Liger, alongside Kullervo Prime.

But that wraps up all the little highlights from Devstream 199. Tau is arriving on December 9th with a 2-hour-long quest, 3 new weapons, Brysko, 12 missions split between Fornax and Perita, and 2 factions to progress in. It is going to be the largest update in Warframe in years. With it just being the start of a long journey going into 2027. If you need to watch the full Devstream for any minute details. You can find it down below!

Tau will, of course, be a free update for all platforms. This includes: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch 1|2, Steam, iOS & Android devices, and PlayStation 4|5.

items.title: ‘It would doom us’: Why Warframe’s massive Tau update isn’t a sequel
Warframe’s Space Mom Isn’t Done Just Yet
items.summary: '[Lotus] is absolutely still relevant. ... She’s not being tucked away'
items.content:
After years of meticulous planning (and a little improvisation), it’s finally happening: Warframe is opening up a second star system, Tau, on December 9. This has involved no small amount of stage setting, including the explosion/implosion/ingestion of an entire planet . But with that pivotal moment came a brief—and, to many, worrisome—message.

After players banded together to feed Eris, a dwarf planet overrun with infested monstrosities, to Praghasa, a space ship that is also the mother of Lotus, who is players’ adoptive mother, Lotus prepared everyone for what’s to come.

“Praghasa can now reach Tau,” she wrote in an in-game message to players. “I must pilot her, and become one with Praghasa. When we get to Tau, it will be with my strength. I will not be able to free myself from her in Tau. I will watch over you, but I can only be with you here on the Origin System. In Tau, I will be my true self: Natahgasa, The Sungazer—blind once again, empty of all but wisdom.”

Upon reading this earlier in November, some players speculated that Lotus was done for—at least in the sense of maintaining her own separate identity and consciousness. They found the implications heartbreaking: In many ways, Lotus is Warframe ’s emotional core, the character who’s been with players since day one, guiding their Tenno—psychic child soldiers who pilot Warframes—out of an amnesiac slumber and through countless missions, leading to reveals of their (and her) true identities. Players call her “space mom” for a reason. It didn’t help, in players’ minds, that Lotus has semi-recently been in and out of the picture for plot reasons. Now, they feared, they’re on the verge of losing her again, this time possibly for good.

But, as part of a recent Warframe: Tau preview event, developer Digital Extremes told Aftermath that the reports of Lotus’ death have been greatly exaggerated.

“[Lotus] is absolutely still relevant,” said creative director Rebb Ford, who is also Lotus’ voice actor. “She is an ongoing series. She’s not being tucked away. It's just a different exploration because, as a character, she had a lot of struggles with the initial Tau vision [set in motion by Ballas, a villain]. She was basically forced to become Praghasa to get people to Tau. [This happened] five years ago now [during Warframe 's New War arc], and I joked that we could have done an Avengers Endgame [-like recap] in theaters again with a bonus sequence just to remind people. But we will be doing our best to emphasize what is beyond permanence and what isn't, because we like to keep our characters around for many, many uses."

Some players speculated that, after all these years of wearing hats on hats on hats like a Team Fortress 2 character, Ford was ready to step back from voice acting and, in service of that, effectively write Lotus out of the game’s future content. That is decidedly not the case.

“There won't be a day next week where I'm not in the recording booth as that feature [of Lotus fusing with Praghasa] plays out,” said Ford.

That said, Ford’s approach to Lotus is unique. When it comes to including her in the story, Ford refuses to let her own biases cloud her judgement.

“I think the truth of that character is, when we have a need for her, we always have a second set of opinions, because I don't feel comfortable giving myself work,” said Ford. “In the most recent case of this Praghasa-Natahgasa moment in Tau, [design director] Pablo [Alonso] and I spoke about it before we proceeded, so that we would make sure it wasn't out of such a conflict of interest.”

Players’ mom becoming one with their grandmother—who, again, is a spaceship—might not strike you as the most intuitive plot beat, but that’s kind of Warframe ’s whole deal. It’s an at-times convoluted mishmash of ideas, stories, and genres, some recent and others 13 years old. One of the development team’s brightest north stars, in fact, is “Keep it weird.”

“The one thing [Alonso] and I reflect on most with the most vigor is ‘Keep it weird,’” said Ford. “The biggest thing we look at is like ‘Is this weird enough?’ And sometimes it's not, and we have to live with that, and then we'll just get weirder soon after.”

Tau is pretty weird. During the preview event, Ford and Warframe director of community and live ops Megan Everett guided viewers through the dripping, Giger-esque caverns of Fornax, an orbital ring city overrun with synthetic beings known as Sentients, who—at least in Fornax, specifically—are addicted to drugs and gambling. There, they encountered mafia members, including hulking brothers who’ll hunt you through missions if you’re playing the game’s more challenging Steel Path mode, and a lounge singer whose microphone is also a Sentient. That’s the fun part of Tau: Pretty much anything can be a Sentient.

"Everything is a Sentient: the microphone, the slot machines, the card table, the ring itself,” said Ford. “There's a moment that I have forbidden anyone [at Digital Extremes] to talk about or market because I want people to see it in the quest."

items.title: Warframe Confirms Tau Release Date, And You Don't Have Long To Wait
items.summary: The devs behind Warframe have confirmed that the Tau update is scheduled to drop on December 9, marking a huge moment for the game.
items.content:
Add ScreenRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover By James Lynch Published Nov 27, 2026, 3:00 PM EST James is a gaming writer from London who has spent thousands of hours exploring titles from every genre. Though he has a particular affinity for multiplayer titles like World of Warcraft, Destiny 2 and League of Legends, he has also put thousands of hours into single-player experiences, from deep RPGs to epic PC strategies. When he's not playing or writing, he can usually be found supporting his beloved Brentford FC. Sign in to your ScreenRant account Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Listen Thread Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Warframe is just about the most consistent live service game around, a testament to what can be done when the development team works closely with the community as a whole. So much so that the game has just been justifiably nominated for the Best Community Support prize at this year's Game Awards .

That said, it feels like the game has been quietly ticking along in the background, building towards something bigger and more impactful (a little like the build towards Marvel's Doomsday in recent months). If you've been following along, then you'll likely know that the next big step is the Tau update, a content release that's just about as big as anything the game has ever seen in one go. Now, all the details have been revealed, and it turns out we'll be playing it far sooner than some of you may have been expecting.

As revealed in today's Devstream 199, Warframe's enormous Tau update is set to hit live servers on December 9, bringing with it an entirely new star system and chart, as well as new locations, enemies, and storylines for players to work through.

On the face of it, it really is difficult to overstate just how impactful this update has the potential of being. It adds the ringed city of Fornax, Warframe's first interconnected social hub, which should do wonders for reinstilling social elements in a community that already collaborates so well with one another.

There are three different hubs to travel between, and you can traverse them in several different ways, either on foot, or via the Highway Network car combat mini-game. At the same time, criminal elements within the city run rife, and there are a bunch of exciting themed activities that will see you nicely embroiled in all of that quickly.

Those include brand-new game modes like Racket, where you'll need to recover stolen funds, and Mayhem, where you turn up and disrupt as many of the mob's operations as possible. Existing mission types have also been remixed in some cases, bringing new life to old staples and making them theme appropriate for the journey across to the Tau System.

The Fornax Informer has also been added with unique mechanics, in which you have to collect newspapers to find clues, eventually building a case and reputation with your new partners. In explaining why this next step is such a monumental moment for the game as a whole, Community Director Megan Everett shared the following statement:

"Today’s Tau reveals come right off the heels of our Epoch Operation: Taubound event where an entire planet got eaten for the greater good of finally going to Tau. It was really special to see how many players were ready and online waiting for what the Operation conclusion was going to bring! Taubound was our most participated in-game event in Warframe’s history. Going to Tau is not only a huge moment for the community, but also for us as creatives looking to up our ante every update. We have set a very high bar for ourselves to ensure Tau feels special and delivers on the trust our players have placed in us over 13 incredible years. We are finally going!"

At the same time, Kullervo Prime Access debuts alongside Warframe: Tau on December 9, alongside two new weapons, the Rauta Prime shotgun and the Vitrica Prime heavy blade.

There's plenty more going on besides, so it's worth checking out the Devstream for yourself. That said, if you've yet to take the leap on Warframe for one reason or another, this next release is bound to bring the community together in a big way, making it the perfect time to start as a newbie.

items.title: Warframe Creative Director Rebecca Ford Calls Tau “The Biggest Swing We Could Do”, but Says December 9 Is Only the Start
items.summary: Digital Extremes announced that Warframe: Tau, which adds the first new star system to the game, will be released on November 9.
items.content:
Canadian developer Digital Extremes has finally given a date for Warframe: Tau , an update players have waited years for. It's the game's first trip beyond its original star system, launching simultaneously on December 9 for free on PC, console, and mobile. Ahead of the Devstream, Community Director Megan Everett and Creative Director Rebecca Ford gave the press a preview from a work-in-progress dev build, followed by a roundtable Q&A. Below is a summary of the presentation and Q&A.

Tau has been mentioned in Warframe's lore for years and teased more heavily over the last five, most notably during the pivotal Tau conversation in The New War . Ford described it as " the biggest swing we could do " for the game, but stressed that December 9 is only the start. At launch, Tau includes two regions, a roughly two-hour quest, new syndicates, and a full album of music. It also arrives immediately after the Epoch Operation: Taubound , which ended with the Infested home world Eris being consumed. Everett noted that Taubound was the most participated-in event in Warframe's history. The Infested will get their response in 2027, when the developer plans an Infested-focused deep dive in the Origin System.

The first Heirloom of 2027, Nezha , will be bundled with a Loki Heirloom. Loki, one of the starter Warframes from the alpha days, will also get a light rework covering synergies within his kit and the role of invisibility and crowd control; full details will be shared in an upcoming official Devstream. The Loki Heirloom includes an optional cloak that uses a new fur shader, part of the tech that the game shares with Soulframe .

Kullervo Prime launches with Tau as its Prime Access, revealed through a combined Prime trailer that also features Styanax. Ford said it had taken six months to go from idea to execution. Kullervo Prime gets increased armor and energy and arrives with two new Prime weapons , the Rauta Prime shotgun and the Vitrica Prime heavy blade. It can be earned for free through gameplay or unlocked instantly with a microtransaction.

A new navigation screen lets players choose between the Origin System and Tau. The first of the two available regions, Parita , will be familiar to players who know Warframe's quests and lore. It's an environmentally volatile desert region hit by sandstorms and home to descendants of the Dax . It features six game modes, including a version of Survival with environmental hazards and an ecological system in which players hunt for larvae and bugs on behalf of Catylac, a young boy focused on science.

Arguably, though, the headline region is Fornax , a ringed Sentient city with a noir, mob-run casino theme (and its own weather system, which, of course, includes rain) and Warframe's first interconnected social hub system. It has three connected hubs :

Players can travel between the hubs in four ways:

Spy returns after a long absence as a vault heist, in which players memorize codes and passwords to break into vaults. Mayhem is a brand-new mode in which you destroy the mob's property, including blowing up its limousines. The press release also lists Racket , where squads recover stolen funds and return them to extorted neighborhoods, and says Fornax offers four remixed versions of existing mission types in total. Tau also introduces new combinable damage types.

Acolytes can't follow players to Tau. Instead, the mob sends the five Hokra Brothers after anyone playing Steel Path missions. Each brother has variants and a personality of his own, and players can meet them off-duty in the casino hub. Steel Essence farming is shared with the Origin System , so it won't become a separate grind, which I'm sure players will be pleased with.

Instead of three separate syndicates, all of Fornax progresses through a single one, The Fornax Informer , a trio of newsies who know and publish everything happening in the city. At rank three, players can start detective work : collecting clues to solve a scandal at the Last Bloom Lounge and earn an exclusive reward. Fornax also has its own skill progression system , with buffs that apply in Fornax missions and unlock by completing challenges.

Fornax also introduces Warframe's first card game , which can be played against the house, against other players, or with a squad. During the demo, Everett won her hand on a final draw. The casino has a lounge singer, and Larynde is accompanied by a Sentient microphone with its own store. Tau's soundtrack is a full album that Ford described as "EDM meets trip hop meets acid wash".

Digital Extremes also proudly noted that Warframe, which now has more than 90 million players , is nominated for Best Community Support at The Game Awards. Watching Geoff Keighley's show on December 10 for 30 minutes with a linked Twitch account earns players a free Caliban.

After the press demo, Everett and Ford added several details about Tau's launch content and DE's plans for 2027 during the subsequent Q&A.

First of all, the studio expects Tau's quest to take roughly two hours , depending on how much time players spend on optional moments. Parita's working codename was " Mad Max Dax ," and the developers called the Mad Max worldview, with its deserts, sandstorms and tribal regression of humanity, the region's main inspiration. Fornax came from a 2023 idea: Digital Extremes wished the return to the Sentients to feel like a cyber Detroit crossed with Atlantic City, and said its sci-fi elements are the furthest Warframe has ever gone. Mass Effect was also cited as a major influence, down to Brisco's design, along with Law & Order (Brisco is named after Lenny Briscoe ), The Sopranos and Boardwalk Empire . The team said the Sentients are the hardest faction to write for in Warframe, and that framing them through crime, mafia, gambling and addiction is what finally made them work.

items.content: Sevagoth Prime and Hydroid Prime, along with their signature Prime Weapons and Prime Accessories, are available together for the first time ever. Sevagoth Prime The Void's perilous tempests require a formidable helmsman to navigate — a role that Sevagoth Prime ceaselessly endures. Command the shadows, suffocating any wayward soul foolish enough to stand before this specter of death. If you're all about dealing swaths of damage over time while simultaneously lingering on thanks to high survivability amidst chaotic firefights, then Sevagoth Prime is the ideal Warframe for you. Hydroid Prime Break your backs and crack your oars should you wish to prevail once the maritime marauder stirs. Hydroid Prime takes control of any battlefield through torrential downpours that rip foes asunder — rendering them more susceptible to Corrosive damage. Then, when the time is right, he can summon creatures from the depths to temporarily suspend enemies with his Tentacle Swarm Ability. Those adamant about crowd control would be wise to give Hydroid Prime a chance. Prime Warframes Want to learn more about Prime Warframes?
